notes.title: Build Update #9: 1.1.41
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

It’s been a while—and we truly appreciate your patience and continued support during our time away. While it’s been over a year since our last update, we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes, and we’re excited to finally bring you a fresh patch packed with meaningful improvements and some exciting new additions to enhance your journey.

Your feedback and bug reports have remained invaluable throughout development, and this update is a direct result of your passion and insights.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Whirlwind Attack Enhancement:[/b] All upgraded Hibino armors now feature new ranged unique-elemental attacks when using the Whirlwind skill.
[*] [b]Fast Travel System:[/b] Introducing [i]Hermes Express[/i]—a new, streamlined way to traverse Talos Castle more efficiently.
[*] [b]Expanded Exploration:[/b] New rooms have been added, and the map has been rearranged to encourage deeper exploration.
[*] [b]Boss Battle Quality of Life: [/b]Boss introductions have been shortened when replaying encounters.
[*] [b]Radical Acceptance for final chapter:[/b] This ability will now persist after acquiring the last armor.
[*] [b]Auriel Blast:[/b] The Auriel Blast ability now activates instantly—no charge time required.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where enemies defeated with Apino’s projectiles weren’t being registered in the Bestiary.
[*] Fixed button rebinding issues that were affecting gameplay.
[/list]
[h2]Balance Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Combo Integration: [/b]Strong Attacks now deal significantly more damage when used as part of a combo.
[*] [b]Elemental Synergy:[/b] Attacks that align with an enemy’s elemental weakness (based on equipped armor) now inflict increased damage.
[*] [b]Armor Boosts: [/b]Equipping upgraded armors now enhances Europa’s base attack power.
[/list]
We’re thrilled to finally reconnect with you, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the changes. Whether you have feedback, a bug to report, or simply want to hang out with fellow players and the dev team, our Discord is the place to be. Your enthusiasm continues to shape the world we’re building together!

notes.title: Build Update #8: 1.0.98
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

As we kick off 2024, we want to express our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and feedback. Over the past few months, we've diligently reviewed your reports, and we're thrilled to share the latest enhancements we've made to elevate your gaming experience.

Here are the key highlights:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38214/Metroidvania_SoulsLike_Bundle/

notes.title: Build Update #4: Performance and Optimization
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope you're all doing well. It's been a month since our last update, where we shared that we have been working on some performance fixes and optimizing general assets throughout the game.

We thank you for your patience and empathy while we work on new fixes and ways to make the game feel better. 

If you want to talk with our dev team, report an issue, or join the community, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/EqWkqRvWPq]Discord[/url]! We'd love to hear from you all!

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[h3]Game Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new visual aid for the light bar has been added when Europa is performing Lullaby or Radical Acceptance.
[*] Radical Acceptance "sweet spot" is now always positioned in the middle of the recovery bar.
[*] Radical Acceptance now recovers less light if it is used immediately consecutively.
[*] The shield recovery speed values have been adjusted for the final armor set.
[*] Health and damage values have been rebalanced and adjusted for all bosses, mid-bosses, and enemies.
[*] The Final Battle and Logon Duck boss fights have been rebalanced based on changes to health recovery mechanics.
[*] The Hekate's Illusion boss has a new attack.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Painting portals have been updated.
[*] Incorrect elevator cinematic animations have been fixed.
[*] Fixes for some of the art assets in the Theater / Workshop.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Falling Stars" attack in the final battle has had a crash bug fixed.
[*] A crash bug related to particles spawning on heat currents has been fixed.
[*] A bug causing the shield recovery bar to appear while Europa has the final armor upgrade has been fixed.
[*] A fix has been applied to ensure the Tantalus Roach boss arena door opens consistently.
[*] A fix has been applied to prevent the Heart of Talos from spawning a shield effect during battle.
[*] The music looping bug in the painting area of Sector E has been fixed.
[*] The animation delay when saving the game has been corrected.
[/list]
[h3]Performance Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy sprite sheets had compression improvements.
[*] Object Pooling has been enhanced to reduce lag by pre-loading common objects (such as attack slashes).
[*] Reduced build size on disk by 6.2 GB thanks to optimizing files, sprite sheets, textures, and materials.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #42: Improving Performance
notes.content:
Hello everyone; we hope you’re all doing well! Summer is fast approaching, and with it, we want to address our focus to improve the game’s performance.

If you played 9 Years of Shadows recently, you’ve noticed we uploaded a localization patch, which includes French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Chinese, and Japanese as available languages. 

We also uploaded several bug fixes across the different patches, most of which solved technical issues due to game optimization. We have been fixing another batch of various bugs and performance issues and are now in a testing phase to check that everything is in order. 

However, we know that some of you have encountered crashes in certain areas, so we wanted to reassure you of our commitment to solving them and working on solutions to prevent future crashes from happening again. 

We thank everyone who has taken the time to report their problems and continue supporting us as we work towards making the game smoother with each patch. 

The following are the main improvements of the past few weeks that will be present in an upcoming patch: 

[list]
[*] Fixed bug RAM issue that was causing some players to encounter problems due to memory leak
[*] Improved the loading system to be more efficient with big textures and assets
[*] Compressed the executable size of the game to reduce space
[*] Improved performance in intensive areas and battles in the game
[*] Improved texture sizes to reduce spike lags
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed bug RAM issue that was causing some players to encounter problems due to memory leak

notes.title: Build Update #3: New languages
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope you’re all doing well. It’s been a month since our release day, and we
could not feel more grateful for everyone’s support, patience, and feedback. We appreciate you
taking the time to report bugs, suggest new elements that could improve the experience, and
read your comments on what 9 Years of Shadows has been for you.

In fact, because we’ve seen many people in different countries willing to play a game that wasn’t
localized in their language, we wanted to get Europa’s story to as many people as possible.
That’s why we worked with a localization team for 9YoS to be accessible in German, French,
Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, and Chinese, as well as making adjustments in Spanish and
English.

We hope this makes the journey more appealing for our community and that everyone can
travel alongside Apino.

Furthermore, we have been fixing many reported bugs that affected the overall gameplay. There
are other bugs we continue to work on, which will be solved in future updates so we keep on
improving everyone’s experience. Our newest patch covers the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Fix for crash due to main character entities memory leak

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Elemental Combat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/287cbda2e99221a5759c254c114e5156d94bd6b2.png[/img]
Hello everyone!
As we near the end of Q3 of our development, we have wonderful news we’ve been dying to share with our amazing community.

As you may know, we’ve recently changed our pixel art to pixel perfect, which means a huge performance improvement for the game. That also means we upgraded Europa’s run and combo animations to fit this new style. Keep in mind your attack variations! Alternating between light and heavy attacks can knock an enemy off balance, and if you use a heavy attack as a finisher, it’ll become stronger!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/c1429f798352fdcf284acceea63c529950a312e3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/57f32de3ab60b318a30f96ef525d39cb2ed9f539.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/31373b910bfff34c507753812343a3f4c8fc5563.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/bc864043333c34931661723fbb1fc0769bdbee74.gif[/img]

But these are more than just combos; Europa’s elemental abilities are vital to progressing the game, as they unlock special areas and are also designed to battle specific enemies. For instance, enemies like these can only be destroyed through lightning, fire, water and earth respectively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/b9ed508fc1ea0b81659bef6fce4e737582f90a1e.png[/img]

Speaking of enemies, we have also been working on some of the backer enemy designs you guys came up with! Now, Talos Castle is full of lore-infused characters that will make the story that much more interesting - and challenging as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/6d045df15b95310f75a0928e316d0eb2934750e4.gif[/img]

Keeping the diverse elemental advantages and disadvantages in mind will be crucial to interact with your surroundings and be ready for combat at the same time, especially knowing how to switch between them to make the most out of Europa’s powers.

And we couldn’t have an update without some gorgeous art pieces from a couple of Talos’ areas; here’s a glimpse of the castle’s entrance and the water area, where Europa's journey will take many twists and turns!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/00fb4cf3ae15386cac07aefce560e2299b401a53.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/acf1bbc630075726c61f929a8a6adceb0c76df77.png[/img]

Speaking of twists, there’s nothing that gives us bigger goosebumps than the newest fire area track. You can feel just how the stakes get higher for Europa and Apino as they venture into this blazing labyrinth while time is ticking. [url=https://soundcloud.com/halberdstudios/9-years-of-shadows-original-soundtrack-furnace-432hz]Check it out[/url]! 

Tracks like this get us extremely excited, especially knowing we’ll be working with talents of Manami Matsumae, Michiru Yamane and Norihiko Hibino’s caliber! Do you like what their characters look like in-game?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/aa9bf64bd06055f71066f4ae678e8a1bcf8d0ba9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/14baefe2096faaf1ce76f283d91d590827d5620b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/c13af91374724116620cec58af7ba692e0254393.png[/img]

Lastly, make sure you’re on the lookout for Future Games Show, Gamescom edition this Thursday, and tune in during the event for a special treat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822346/5dba3a910b64fb7be28ad82131316e23ba73903f.png[/img]

If you’re as thrilled about Europa’s adventure as we are, don’t forget to wishlist 9 Years of Shadows! You can also join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/QQpmcn9UvN]Discord[/url] where you can talk with other fans. 

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

The Halberd Team

tags.feature: As you may know, we’ve recently changed our pixel art to pixel perfect, which means a huge performance improvement for the game.
That also means we upgraded Europa’s run and combo animations to fit this new style.
But these are more than just combos; Europa’s elemental abilities are vital to progressing the game, as they unlock special areas and are also designed to battle specific enemies.
Speaking of enemies, we have also been working on some of the backer enemy designs you guys came up with!
